description:
You are a technical writer working on organizing software documentation. You have an INI configuration file located at /home/user/docs/config/settings.ini with several settings inside multiple sections. Your task is to extract all key-value pairs under the [documentation] section of this INI file and save them into a new file at /home/user/docs/config/doc_settings_extracted.txt.

The required output format in doc_settings_extracted.txt is:
- One key=value pair per line, preserving the order as it appears under the [documentation] section in the original INI file.
- Do not include any section headers, comments, or values from other sections.
- There should be no extra spaces or blank lines in the output.

After completion, the content of /home/user/docs/config/doc_settings_extracted.txt must exactly match the [documentation] section of the INI file, formatted as described above.
